title: Pure Pot of
summary: A TCG-legal Pot of collection paired with Spirit of the Pot of Greed, Avatar of The Pot and a Normal Summon stun-beatdown core. Because Pot of Duality locks out Special Summons and Pot of Desires, Extravagance and Prosperity banish cards in bulk, the monster lineup runs anti-meta Normal Summons and Gren Maju Da Eiza.

summary.title: Starters & Draw Vessels
points: Pot of Desires banishes the top 10 cards of your Deck face-down to draw 2 cards, immediately giving Gren Maju Da Eiza 4000 ATK and DEF.

Pot of Extravagance and Pot of Prosperity (each Limited to 1) banish 3 or 6 cards face-down from the Extra Deck at the start of Main Phase 1 to draw 2 or excavate up to 6 cards for a key stun piece, adding another 1200 to 2400 ATK to Gren Maju.
Pot of Duality excavates the top 3 cards of your Deck and adds 1 to your hand at the cost of no Special Summons that turn, which costs the Normal Summon stun monsters nothing.

summary.title: Opening: Pot Spells + Stun Normal Summon
steps: At the start of Main Phase 1, activate Pot of Extravagance, Pot of Prosperity or Pot of Dichotomy before any other draw or search effects.
Follow with Pot of Desires or Pot of Duality to dig into your stun monsters and Solemn Counter Traps.
Normal Summon Inspector Boarder, Thunder King Rai-Oh or a Koa'ki Meiru Rock, Set Solemn Judgment or Solemn Warning, and pass behind a locked board.

summary.title: Recycling Pots
points: Pot of Dichotomy shuffles 3 monsters with different Types from your GY into the Deck at the start of Main Phase 1 to draw 2 cards, fueled by Rock (Koa'ki Meiru Guardian and Overload, Avatar of The Pot), Thunder (Thunder King Rai-Oh), Machine (Inspector Boarder), Fiend (Gren Maju) and Fairy (Spirit of the Pot of Greed).
Pot of Avarice shuffles 5 monsters from your GY into the Deck to draw 2 cards once the self-tributing stun monsters pile up.
Pot of Acquisitiveness shuffles 3 banished monsters back into the Deck as a Quick-Play to draw 1 card, and Pot of Benevolence returns 2 cards from either GY to the Deck.

summary.title: Control & Finisher
points: Koa'ki Meiru Guardian tributes itself to negate a monster effect, Koa'ki Meiru Overload tributes itself to negate a Summon, and Thunder King Rai-Oh stops both players from searching while your Pot Spells draw instead.

Inspector Boarder shuts down monster effects on the field while you control no Extra Deck monster types, and Gren Maju Da Eiza closes the game in a single Normal Summon swing after Desires and Extravagance resolve.
The Extra Deck runs 3 copies each of Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired Tapir and Gallant Granite so at least 1 copy survives random banishes from Pot of Extravagance.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Pot of Greed is Forbidden in the TCG, so Spirit of the Pot of Greed and Avatar of The Pot represent it alongside every legal Pot Spell.
